Official Cider Sizing help, Body Size (Curve range)

notes: Hong Kong fast-fashion brand, on-demand model similar to SHEIN. Cider's Sizing help lists body measurements against UK sizes, for a standard range (XXS–XL) and a Curve range (0XL–5XL). It says the size comparison is for reference only, so check each item's Product Size too. Popular on TikTok, lots of secondhand on Vinted/Depop.
audit: Stored policy page has no chart; product-page Sizing help (Body Size, UK Size, cm toggle) does. Standard rows from a standard item, Curve rows from a Curve item, printed as shown ('78.0-82.0' stored 78-82). Old M uk 8-10 88/69/93 now M uk 10 91-95/71-75/96-100; old XL uk 12-14 96/77/101 now XL uk 16 101-105/81-86/106-110; old XXL row removed, curve now 0XL-5XL with heights and weights not stored. US/EU removed (not read). Third-party fit-review source removed. 'Runs 1-2 sizes small' and 'Chinese sizing' text replaced: the chart maps to UK sizes directly.
